SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S.B. 81534-
S.I, Special Branch 62xxxx, 42 39
REPORT
Date December 9, 1939.
Subject. Armed Police Headquarters of Zau Woo Kying - dissolved.
Made by. D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford

It is reported that the Armed Police Headquarters
of Zau Woo Kying (武裝警察大隊) was dissolved
on December 1, 1939 by order of the Japanese Military
authorities on account of the undesirable character
of many of the members of the unit. Han Chun
(韓), the commander, however, has been transfer-
red to the "China Peace National Salvation Alliance
Army" organized by Wang Ching Wei, as commander of
the First Route of the Army with Headquarters establish-
ed in the Yangchow Guild, situated in the vicinity of
Tai Yang Miao, Chiaotung Road, Chapei. A small
part of his men were incorporated in the Army while
the remaining number dispersed in Zau Woo Kying and
other nearby villages.

It will be recalled that the Armed Police
Headquarters of Zau Woo Kying was formed in April,
1939 under the auspices of the Special Service Section
of the Japanese military and had enrolled by June,
1939, approximately 1,000 persons. However, in the
same month, some 200 of these men defected to the
guerillas in Nan Jao Village, Pootung, to which they
had been transferred after a short period at Nan Sing
Jao on the S.H.M.R. line where they took over garrison
duties from Japanese troops transferred to Hangchow.

（批：The Roberts）
(D. R.)
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 12 DEC. 1939 B）

报告
日期：1939年12月9日。
主题：赵雍庆（Zau Woo Kying）武装警察总部——已解散。
制作人：副督察廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien） 转呈人：督察克劳福德（Crawford）

据报，赵雍庆（武裝警察大隊）武装警察总部已于1939年12月1日奉日本军方当局命令解散，原因是该部队许多成员品行不端。然而，指挥官韩春（韓，音译）已被调往由汪精卫组织的“中国和平救国同盟军”，担任该军第一路军司令，总部设在闸北交通路太阳庙附近的扬州会馆。他手下的一小部分人被编入该军，其余人员则散居于赵雍庆及其他附近村庄。

需指出的是，赵雍庆武装警察总部是在日本军方特务机关的支持下于1939年4月成立的，至1939年6月已招募约1,000人。然而，就在同月，其中约200人叛逃至浦东南焦村（Nan Jao Village）的游击队，此前他们曾被调往沪杭铁路线上的南星桥（Nan Sing Jao，音译），在那里从调往杭州的日军手中接管了驻防任务。

（批注：The Roberts）
(D. R.)
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1939年12月12日 B）

CHINA PRESS.
DEC 1939

British Military Authorities -
Hold Gang Of 6 Mystery Men

Not four but six men were arrest-
ed by the British military patrol
on Tunsin Road Monday morning,
it was revealed by British Military
Headquarters yesterday. The men,
four of whom were armed, are all
in the hands of the British
Military.
In a statement issued yesterday,
the British Military Headquarters
announced:
"The British Military authorities
have in custody six Chinese, four
of whom were armed. This party,
wearing Chinese dress, was arrested
on Tunsin Road at 11 a.m. on
Monday, December 4. They claim
to have entered the British sector
for the purpose of arresting Chin-
ese.
"British military authorities
intend to retain these men in
custody until such time as their
identity has been established and a
request for their release has been
received from some responsible
authority."
As exclusively reported in THE
CHINA PRESS yesterday, the men
were taken into custody while they
were intimidating at pistol-point a
shroff of the Danish-owned Shang-
hai Milk Supply Co., Ltd., at 145
Tunsin Road. It was alleged Mon-
day that these men were policemen
of the "City Government" attach-
ed to the Tsaohoching Station of the
puppet police force.
The shroff was one Mau Miao-
sah, owner of a factory in a Chin-
ese village off Tunsin Road whose
business burned down recently. Two
neighboring houses were destroyed
in the course of the fire, it was
alleged, and the owners of these
homes are seeking damages from
Mau.
Unable to obtain satisfaction from
the shroff, the villagers appealed to
the puppet police of Tsaohoching
Station, it was stated. This action
resulted in the abortive attempted
arrest of the shroff Monday.

（批：File 12/12）

《字林西报》（CHINA PRESS）。
1939年12月

英国军方当局——
拘捕六名神秘男子团伙

英国军方司令部昨日透露，周一上午在敦信路被英国军事巡逻队逮捕的不是四人，而是六人。这些人中四人持有武器，目前均处于英国军方控制之下。
英国军方司令部在昨日发表的一份声明中宣布：
“英国军方当局已拘留六名中国人，其中四人持有武器。这群人身穿中式服装，于12月4日星期一上午11时在敦信路被捕。他们声称进入英方辖区是为了逮捕中国人。
“英国军方当局打算将这些人在押，直至查明其身份并收到有关负责当局提出的释放请求为止。”
正如《字林西报》昨日独家报道的那样，这些人是在敦信路145号持枪恐吓丹资上海牛奶供应有限公司（Shanghai Milk Supply Co., Ltd.）的一名出纳员时被拘留的。周一有指控称，这些人是伪警察部队曹家泾站所属的“市政府”警察。
该出纳员名为毛妙萨（Mau Miao-sah，音译），是敦信路外一个中国村庄的一家工厂主，其业务近期被烧毁。据称，火灾过程中两栋邻近房屋被毁，这些房屋的业主正向毛某寻求赔偿。
据称，村民因无法从出纳员那里获得满意结果，遂向曹家泾站的伪警察求助。这一行动导致了周一企图逮捕出纳员的失败尝试。

（批注：归档 12/12）

SHANGHAI TIMES.

DEC 6 1939

BRITISH MILITARY
HOLD CHINESE

Men Arrested On Monday
For Illegal Operation
In British Sector

The British military authorities
were yesterday still detaining the
six plainclothes Chinese, who were
arrested on Monday morning. for
having entered the British Defence
Sector, whilst four of them were
armed. and attempted to arrest a
Chinese.

The British, military authorities
announced yesterday afternoon that
they intend to retain these men in
custody until such time as their
identity has been established
and a request for their release has
been received from some respon-
sible authority.

The men were arrested outside
145 Tunsin Road at about 11
o'clock on Monday morning after
they had attempted to arrest the
shroff of the Shanghai Milk Sup-
ply Company, a Danish concern.
The men were taken into custody
by a British military patrol when
they attempted to arrest the Chi-
nese shroff and four of them
pointed pistols at him. The British
Tommies disarmed the men and
led them away.

It is believed that the men were
after the shroff in connection with
a fire that had occurred recently
in the City Government area, it
being alleged that neighbours sus-
tained damage when the shroff's
factory in the outside areas had
burned down. The men were ap-
parently trying to arrest him in
order to extort money from him.

《上海泰晤士报》（SHANGHAI TIMES）。

1939年12月6日

英国军方
扣押中国人

周一因在英方辖区非法行动
而被捕的男子

英国军方当局昨日仍在拘留周一上午被捕的六名便衣中国人，因为他们进入了英国防御区，且其中四人持有武器并试图逮捕一名中国人。

英国军方当局昨日下午宣布，他们打算将这些人在押，直至查明其身份并收到有关负责当局提出的释放请求为止。

这些人于周一上午11点左右在敦信路145号外被捕，当时他们试图逮捕丹资企业上海牛奶供应公司的出纳员。当这些人试图逮捕这名中国出纳员并四人用枪指着他时，英国军事巡逻队将他们拘留。英国士兵解除了他们的武装并将他们带走。

据信，这些人追查该出纳员与近期在“市政府”区域发生的一场火灾有关，据称当出纳员在外围区域的工厂被烧毁时，邻居遭受了损失。这些人显然试图逮捕他以向他勒索钱财。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
DEC 6 1939

British Patrol
Holds Chinese
Six Men Arrested in
Tunsin Road ; Four
Of Party Armed

Six Chinese, four of whom were armed, are being detained by the British military authorities in Shanghai after they had been apprehended by a British military patrol on Monday morning outside a business establishment on Tunsin Road where they were attempting to intimidate a Chinese by a show of force. Until they are claimed by a responsible authority the men will be detained. Their weapons have been confiscated.

In a statement issued yesterday the British military authorities stated: "We have in custody six Chinese, four of whom were armed. The party, wearing Chinese dress, was arrested in Tunsin Road on December 4 at 11 a.m. The men claimed to have entered the British defence sector for the purpose of arresting Chinese.

"The British military authorities intend to retain these men in custody until such time as their identity has been established and a request for their release has been received from a responsible authority."

Questioned by a "North-China Daily News" reporter yesterday a British military official denied a report that the men were members of the "Special Municipality" police. "I don't know who they are," he added, "and they will be kept in custody until someone claims them."

Displaying Weapons

When taken into custody the men were displaying their weapons in front of several Chinese, one of whom, it was believed, they intended to take away with them. The military patrol immediately surrounded the men and they were led away. What their motive was has not yet been ascertained although one of the men stated that they had come into the defence sector to effect an arrest.

According to eye-witnesses of the incident, it appeared as if the men were about to stage an armed robbery when a Chinese employee left the premises of the Danish-owned Shanghai Milk Supply Company. A telephone call was immediately put through to Bubbling Well police station and a squad of police turned out. Before their arrival, however, the British patrol came on the scene and effected the men's arrest.

In Chinese circles it is believed that the men are members of the Nanking Armed Plainclothes Corps, stationed at Tsaoching Prison. This could not be confirmed, however, and so far their identity remains a mystery. Enquiries are still proceeding.

《字林西报》（NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS）。
1939年12月6日

英国巡逻队
扣押中国人
六人在敦信路被捕；
团伙中四人持械

六名中国人，其中四人持械，在上海被英国军方当局拘留，此前他们于周一上午在敦信路一家商号外被英国军事巡逻队抓获，当时他们正试图通过展示武力恐吓一名中国人。在有负责当局认领之前，这些人将被拘留。他们的武器已被没收。

英国军方当局在昨日发表的一份声明中称：“我们已拘留六名中国人，其中四人持械。这群人身穿中式服装，于12月4日上午11时在敦信路被捕。这些人声称进入防御区是为了执行逮捕中国人的任务。

“英国军方当局打算将这些人在押，直至查明其身份并收到负责当局提出的释放请求为止。”

一位英国军方官员昨日在接受《字林西报》记者询问时，否认了有关这些人是“特别市”警察成员的报道。“我不知道他们是谁，”他补充说，“在有人认领之前，他们将被关押。”

展示武器

在被拘留时，这些人正在几名中国人面前展示武器，据信他们打算带走其中一人。军事巡逻队立即包围了这些人并将他们带走。虽然其中一人表示他们进入防御区是为了执行逮捕，但其动机尚未查明。

据事件目击者称，当一名中国雇员离开丹资上海牛奶供应公司场所时，这些人似乎正准备实施武装抢劫。随即有人打电话给静安寺警察局，一队警察出动。然而，在他们到达之前，英国巡逻队赶到现场并实施了逮捕。

在中国圈子里，人们认为这些人是驻扎在曹家泾监狱的南京武装便衣队成员。但这无法得到证实，到目前为止，他们的身份仍是个谜。调查仍在进行中。

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.

DEC 6 - 1939

Arrested Chinese
Complain At Food
Of British Troops

Tunsin Road “Nobodies’ Babies” Given Ration
Of Chinese Chow; Eggs, Bacon Removed
From Menu After Last Episode

Another bunch of Nobody’s Babies is being looked after in the British Military Creche on Great Western Road, in the form of the six men who tried to “arrest” a shroff of the Shanghai Milk Supply Company on Monday morning.

This is the second batch to be held by the British Military, and it is going to receive treatment different to that accorded to the 16 green clad men arrested and held several days recently until the Japanese finally claimed them. The present group is to receive rations on a Chinese, rather than British scale, thanks to the behavior of the first batch.

Two Rashers

The 16, arrested for functioning illegally on a municipal road and apparently belonging to no official organization, were fed by the British Army on a scale of $1 per man per day. Each of the 16, for instance, received two eggs and two rashers of bacon for breakfast (whereas the Tommies themselves receive but one rasher), and yet had the audacity to complain of the scarcity of food.

No mistake is being made about the six at present in custody. They are to be fed Chinese chow, which is to cost 20 cents per man per day, or as near to that as possible. A bowl of rice, with cabbage, or possibly some meat, three times a day, or something of the sort, will be their rations. They will be given as much as (possibly more than) what they normally get, but there won’t be any more two rashers of bacon.

Taken Over

The men were held by the Police until 3 p.m. yesterday, when the British military, who had arrested the men in the first place, took them over, with the intention of holding them until some responsible person or organization claims them.

Four of the six were carrying pistols (which the British have now confiscated) when seized on Tunsin Road, outside the Danish owned Shanghai Milk Supply Company on Monday morning. Members of the Nanking Government Armed Plain Clothes Corps attached to Tsaochoching prison, they were in company with two Chin-

ese who had complained of damage to their property in a badlands fire.

Small Factory

The fire had broken out in a small factory owned by the dairy concern’s shroff, and apparently the owners of the adjoining property were trying to extort some money from him, through the armed plain clothes men, as compensation. The shroff was carrying $600 of the dairy’s money when held up on Tunsin Road outside the dairy.

As stated in the Shanghai Evening Post yesterday, the four armed men are not members of the Ta Tao police, were apparently acting independently of the latter, and apparently belong to one of the many organizations, corps or gangs which have functioned in the badlands since the Japanese penetrated into the area.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》（SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY）。

1939年12月6日

被捕中国人
抱怨英军伙食

敦信路“无名氏之子”获配中式口粮；
上次事件后鸡蛋、培根从菜单中移除

另一群“无名氏之子”正受到大西路英国军方托儿所的照顾，形式就是周一早上试图“逮捕”上海牛奶供应公司出纳员的那六个人。

这是英国军方扣留的第二批人，他们将受到不同于最近几天扣留并最终由日本人认领的16名绿衣男子的待遇。鉴于第一批人的表现，目前这批人将获得中式而非英式标准的口粮。

两片培根

那16人因在市政道路上非法活动且显然不属于任何官方组织而被捕，英军按每人每天1美元的标准供养他们。例如，这16人每人的早餐包括两个鸡蛋和两片培根（而英国士兵本人只得到一片），然而他们竟厚颜无耻地抱怨食物短缺。

目前被拘留的六人不会搞错。他们将食用中式饭菜，成本约为每人每天20美分，或尽可能接近这个数字。一碗米饭，配卷心菜，或者可能有些肉，一天三次，或类似的东西，将是他们的口粮。他们会得到不少于（甚至可能多于）他们平时得到的食物，但不会再有两片培根了。

接管

这些人由警察拘留至昨天下午3点，随后最初逮捕他们的英国军方将他们接管，意图将其扣留直至有负责人或组织认领。

周一上午，这六人在敦信路丹资上海牛奶供应公司外被抓获时，其中四人携带手枪（现已被英方没收）。他们是隶属于曹家泾监狱的南京政府武装便衣队成员，同行的还有两名中国人，后者投诉其财产在一场混乱地区的火灾中受损。

小工厂

火灾发生在牛奶公司出纳员拥有的一家小工厂内，显然相邻物业的业主正试图通过武装便衣人员向他勒索一些钱作为赔偿。该出纳员在奶品公司外的敦信路被拦截时，身上带着奶品公司的600美元。

正如《上海晚邮报》昨天所述，这四名武装人员并非大盗（Ta Tao，音译）警察的成员，显然独立于后者行动，并且显然属于自日本人渗透进该地区以来在该混乱地区活动的众多组织、队伍或帮派之一。

归档
E 6/12

SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.
1938

Plainclothesmen
Held By Police

Tunsin Road Extortion
By Armed Nanking
Officials Halted

Four members of the "Nanking Government Armed Plain Clothes Corps" are today being held by the Shanghai Municipal Police, following their arrest outside 145 Tunsin Road yesterday morning, when they were trying to arrest a shroff employed by the Shanghai Milk Supply Company, a Danish concern.
The shroff, Meh Ling-fah, had the sum of $600 on him, belonging to the dairy, and the obvious conclusion reached by other employees of the dairy, who saw the affair, was that the shroff was being held up by armed robbers. A telephone call was therefore put in to Bubbling Well Police Station, where a squad immediately turned out.
British Army Patrol
In the mean time, however, a British Army patrol truck, manned by a squad with a machinegun, came along the road. The Tommies spotted the holdup, and swung into action. The four armed men were deprived of their pistols, and they and their two unarmed companions put under arrest by the SMP crew of an armored car that came on the scene by chance just after the British military squad.
A couple of minutes later the squad from Bubbling Well station arrived, and there was quite an imposing gathering of armed force on the Tunsin Road.
Fire Claim
Police found great difficulty in getting to the bottom of the affair and in establishing the identity of the six men. Ultimately, however, it was discovered that the shroff had built up a small factory in the badlands, that it had burnt down a month ago, doing damage to the adjoining properties, and that the owners of the latter had been complaining of this.
The six arrested men included the two complainants. The four armed men proved to be members, not of the Ta Tao police organization itself, but of the Nanking Armed Plain Clothes Corps, stationed at Tsaohoching prison.

On SMC Road
Functionally illegally on an SMC road, in plain clothes and carrying pistols, the four men were apparently acting apart from the Ta Tao police, and were out for squeeze on their own.
No charges, however, were preferred against the men in the District Court this morning, because of the political angle in the affair. The first report of the holdup and arrests was given at 8:30 p.m. yesterday in the Shanghai Evening Post news broadcast over radio station XMHC.
Many Organizations
This organization of Nanking Government Armed Plainclothes Corps is yet another of the many functioning in the badlands nowadays, each out to collect what squeeze it can for itself. Some of them are declared not to have "official" connection, to judge from the Chinese press.
The "Peace National Salvation Army" (Ho Pin Chiu Kuo Chung) and the "Peace Alliance Army" (Ho Pin Tung Meng Chung) in Shanghai have no connection whatsoever with Mr. Wang Ching-wei, the secretariat of the "central executive committee" of the "orthodox" Kuomintang has announced in a notice appearing in the Central China Daily News.
Tut Tut
The announcement declared that Mr. Wang had recently heard reports that unscrupulous persons have been kidnapping persons for ransom and forcibly collecting military expenses under the pretext of being members of these two armies and being connected with the Kuomintang leader. "This is extremely deplorable," the notice said.
The notice is worded in such a way that Mr. Wang's connections with these armies in other districts are not explicitly denied.

（手写批注：Lee C 6/12）

1938年

便衣人员
被警方拘留

武装南京官员在
同孚路实施的勒索
被制止

四名“南京政府武装便衣队”成员今天上午被上海公共租界工部局警务处羁押，此前他们于昨天上午在同孚路145号外试图逮捕一名受雇于丹麦企业上海牛奶供应公司的收银员时被捕。
该收银员梅凌发（Meh Ling-fah，音译）身上携带着属于乳品公司的600元款项，目睹此事的其他乳品公司员工得出的明显结论是，该收银员正遭到武装劫匪的抢劫。因此，有人向静安寺巡捕房打电话报警，一队警员随即出动。
英军巡逻队
然而与此同时，一辆由配备机枪的小分队驾驶的英国陆军巡逻卡车沿路驶来。英军士兵发现了这起抢劫案，并立即采取行动。这四名武装男子被缴去手枪，随后，就在英军小分队之后偶然赶到现场的一辆装甲车上的工部局警务处人员将这四名武装男子及其两名无武装同伴逮捕。
几分钟后，静安寺巡捕房的小分队抵达，同孚路上出现了相当庞大的武装力量集结场面。
火灾索赔
警方在查清此事真相及确认六名男子身份方面遇到了极大困难。然而最终发现，该收银员在“歹土”（badlands，指日占区或法租界等治安混乱区域）建立了一家小工厂，该工厂于一个月前烧毁，并对相邻物业造成损害，而这些相邻物业的业主一直对此提出投诉。
六名被捕男子中包括两名投诉人。经查证，这四名武装男子并非大特务机构本身的成员，而是驻扎在曹河泾监狱的南京武装便衣队成员。

在工部局道路上
这四名人身着便衣、携带手枪，在工部局道路上非法行使职能，显然独立于大特务机构行动，旨在自行进行勒索。
然而，由于此事涉及政治因素，今晨在地方法院并未对这些人提出指控。关于此次抢劫及逮捕的首次报道于昨晚8点30分通过XMHC电台的《上海晚邮报》新闻广播播出。
众多组织
这个南京政府武装便衣队组织只是当今在“歹土”活动的众多组织之一，每个组织都力求为自己搜刮钱财。据中文报刊判断，其中一些组织宣称没有“官方”联系。
国民党“正统”派“中央执行委员会”秘书处在《华中日报》刊登的一则通告中宣布，上海的“和平救国军”（Ho Pin Chiu Kuo Chung）和“和平同盟军”（Ho Pin Tung Meng Chung）与汪精卫先生没有任何关系。
啧啧
该通告称，汪先生最近获悉报告，有不法分子冒充这两支军队的成员并与这位国民党领导人有关联，绑架人员索取赎金并强行征收军费。“这极其令人遗憾，”通告说。
该通告的措辞方式并未明确否认汪先生在其他地区与这些军队的联系。

（手写批注：Lee C 6/12）

December 5, 1939.
ARMED POLICE HEADQUARTERS OF ZAU WOO KYUNG

The Armed Police Headquarters of Zau Woo Kyung
(曹与湾) was established on April 10th 1939 under
the auspices of the Special Service Section of the
Japanese Military. On its inauguration its objects
were declared to be the establishment of an armed
police force of 15,000 men and to induce Chinese
guerillas to surrender to the Japanese presumably
to be incorporated into the ranks of the organization
in question. As its title reveals the main body
of this force is quartered at Zau Woo Kyung, site
of the former Model Prison, a village near Lunghwa.
The chief of the body is one Han Chun (韩钧),
former Brigadier General under Marshal Wu Pei Fu,
while Colonel Nishimura of the Special Service
Section and ex-Senior Advisor to the "Shanghai City
Government" is its Advisor.

At its inception the Armed Police Headquarters
enrolled some 400 constables. By the beginning of
June the number of men enlisted had risen to 1,000,
of whom 760 were stationed at Headquarters, 40
constables at a branch office in Fah Hua Village,
Western District, O.O.L., 100 at Tsapao and the
remaining 100 men at Siking. Yao Ah Sung (姚阿松
alias Yao Ts Tsen alias Yao Ts Tu(姚子都),
a former detective sub-inspector attached to Crime
Branch Headquarters, Shanghai Municipal Police, was
appointed Chief of Staff at the Headquarters which
comprise the following sections:- (1) Adjutants Office,
(2) Staff Office, (3) Secretariat, (4) Military Court,
(5) Commissariat, (6) Medical Service Department, (7)
General Affairs Department and (8) Intelligence Office.

1939年12月5日。
曹与湾武装警察总部

曹与湾（Zau Woo Kyung，音译）武装警察总部于1939年4月10日在日本军方特务机关的支持下成立。在其成立之初，其目标被宣布为建立一支15,000人的武装警察部队，并诱使中国游击队向日本人投降， presumably（原文如此，意为“大概”）以便将其编入该组织的队伍。正如其名称所示，该部队的主力驻扎在曹与湾，即龙华附近的一个村庄，原模范监狱所在地。
该部队首领为韩钧（Han Chun），曾任吴佩孚元帅麾下的少将，而特务机关的西村上校（Colonel Nishimura）及前“上海市政府”高级顾问担任其顾问。

在该武装警察总部成立之初，招募了约400名警员。到6月初，入伍人数已增至1,000人，其中760人驻扎在总部，40名警员驻守在外滩西区法华村的一处分支机构，100人驻守乍浦，其余100人驻守泗泾。姚阿松（Yao Ah Sung，又名姚子珍 Yao Ts Tsen，又名姚子都 Yao Ts Tu），前上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事部总部侦探副督察，被任命为总部参谋长，总部下设以下部门：(1) 副官处，(2) 参谋处，(3) 秘书处，(4) 军事法庭，(5) 军需处，(6) 医务处，(7) 总务处，以及 (8) 情报处。

(2)
An additional department was added later in the
form of a Detective Branch in charge of one Koo Tao
Hwa (顾祝同), concurrently chief of the General
Affairs Department, assisted by a Green Paung follower
and drug trafficker named Woo An Pang (胡安邦).
On June 24, 200 men of the Headquarters were
transferred to Nan Sing Jao (南星桥) on the
Shanghai-Hangchow Railway to take over garrison duties
from Japanese troops there who had been transferred
to Hangchow. However these men on being transferred
to Nan Jao Village, Fengyien, Pootung, immediately
defected to the guerillas in Fengyien city taking
their arms, every man is stated to have possessed a
rifle, and four machine guns with them.
On July 21st, three members of this Armed Police
Force opened fire on members of the Municipal Police
who attempted to search them on Stone Bridge Road
which they were using to enter the Settlement from
Chapei. Two of the men were shot dead by the return
fire of the Police while the third was wounded and
arrested. A check of the weapons carried by these
men revealed that they had been used in pro-Japanese
terrorist crimes.
In the same month, it was found that the
Headquarters had established a recruiting office in
a Settlement hotel.
On September 14th, an attempt was made to
assassinate Han Chun, the Commander of the Headquarters,
in the French Concession.
No recent activities of this body have come to
light.

后来增设了一个部门，即侦探科，由顾祝同（Koo Tao Hwa，音译，注：此处原文人名与历史人物顾祝同同名，但语境存疑，依要求保留原文拼音并音译）负责，他同时兼任总务处处长，由一名青帮分子兼毒品贩子胡安邦（Woo An Pang，音译）协助。
6月24日，总部200名人员被调往沪杭铁路上的南星桥（Nan Sing Jao，音译），接替已调往杭州的日军在那里的驻防任务。然而，这些人在被调往浦东奉贤的南乔村（Nan Jao Village，音译）后，立即携械投奔奉贤城的游击队，据说每人拥有一支步枪，并携带四挺机枪。
7月21日，该武装警察部队的三名成员在石桥路向试图搜查他们的工部局警务处警员开火，当时他们正利用该路从闸北进入租界。其中两人被警方还击击毙，第三人受伤被捕。对这些人所携武器的检查显示，这些武器曾被用于亲日恐怖犯罪活动。
同月，发现该总部在租界的一家酒店内设立了征兵办事处。
9月14日，在法租界发生了一起刺杀该总部指挥官韩钧（Han Chun）的未遂事件。
该组织近期的活动尚未曝光。

ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION OF A POLICE "COMMANDER"
In connection with the attempt on the life
of Han Chuin (韓) alias Chang. Yung-dao (張雲濤),
"Commander" of the Police Corps of the Shanghai City
Government Police Bureau, which took place opposite
Passage 313, Rue Ratard, at 11.30 a.m. September 14, it
is learned that after he was struck by two bullets in
the back, Han Chuin boarded his private motor car and
ordered his chauffeur to drive to the Foo Min Hospital
in Hongkew.
It is said that his wounds are so serious
that his life is in danger. It is also learned that the
Police are making an investigation to ascertain whether
the two persons arrested at scene of the shooting affray
have any connection with the attempt.
Another report states Han Chuin was
examined by Japanese doctors who found the bullets
embedded in his body. An operation was performed and
the bullets were taken out. Han's condition is very
serious.

《申报》、《新晚报》及《中美日报》：1937年9月16日下午
警察“司令”遇刺未遂

据悉，9月14日上午11点30分，在上海市政府警察局警察队“司令”韩春（Han Chuin，音译，又名张云涛 Chang Yung-dao）于拉达路（Rue Ratard）313弄对面遭遇的生命袭击事件中，韩春背部中两弹后，登上其私人汽车，命令司机驶往虹口的福民医院。
据说他的伤势非常严重，生命垂危。另悉，警方正在进行调查，以确定在枪战现场被捕的两人与此次未遂刺杀是否有关联。
另一份报告称，韩春接受了日本医生的检查，医生发现子弹嵌在其体内。随后进行了手术，取出了子弹。韩的病情非常严重。

September 15, 1939.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

ANTI-JAPANESE TERRORISTS ATTACK HAN CHUIN, COMMANDER
OF MERCHANT VOLUNTEER CORPS IN THE WESTERN DISTRICT

As Mr. Han Chuin, Commander
of the Merchants Volunteer Corps in the Western District,
accompanied by his interpreter Kin Den San and a
friend, was walking in front of the Liu San Boarding House
on Rue Ratard, French Concession, at 11 a.m. September 14,
three desperadoes all of whom were dressed in white
shirts and foreign trousers, opened fire at Han Chuin
and then quickly disappeared from the scene.
Mr. Han Chuin has wounded
in the left shoulder and the chest and he is now in a
serious condition at the Foo Ming Hospital. Kin Den
San, the interpreter, who is attending to him, states
that anti-Japanese terrorists were responsible for the
attack.

《大陆新报》

反日恐怖分子袭击西区商团团长韩春

9月14日上午11时，西区商团团长韩春先生在其翻译金登山（Kin Den San，音译）和一位朋友的陪同下，走在法租界拉达路刘三寄宿舍前时，三名身穿白衬衫和西裤的亡命之徒向韩春开火，随后迅速逃离现场。
韩春先生左肩和胸部受伤，目前在福民医院情况危急。正在照顾他的翻译金登山称，此次袭击系反日恐怖分子所为。

page_data.en:
NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS,

SEP 16 1939

“Special Government”
Official Shot

Fails to Report to
Concession Police

Han Chung, alias Chang Yun-tao, commandant of the police of the “Special City Government of Shanghai” for the Fah Hwa, Lunghwa, Kiangwan, Tsaohotsing and Hungjao areas, was shot and wounded just before noon on Thursday as he was about to drive away in his car from his French Concession home at Lane 313, House 7, Route Delastre, according to Japanese reports.

French Concession police questioned on the incident on Thursday evening said that they had no knowledge of the shooting and this was later substantiated by the report that Han, although injured in the back by one of the four shots fired at him by the gunman, preferred to drive into Japanese-occupied territory to make a report to the Japanese authorities on the matter.

As no alarm was raised by Han, the gunman managed to escape and investigations made by the Concession police reveal that the man who was arrested at the corner of Route des Soeurs and Rue Ratard shortly before noon on Thursday, and who fired three shots at the police, resulting in an injury to his own shoulder, could not be responsible for this shooting as three rounds of ammunition were stated to have been found in his pistol, thus accounting for the total of six which the magazine held.

（批：Read 16/9）

1939年9月16日

“特别政府”
官员遭枪击

未向租界警方报案

据日文报道，周四中午前不久，“上海特别市政府”负责法华、龙华、江湾、曹河泾和虹桥地区警察的司令韩忠（Han Chung，又名张云涛 Chang Yun-tao），在准备从其位于法租界德拉司脱路（Route Delastre）7号313弄的寓所驾车离开时遭枪击受伤。

周四晚间就此事件询问的法租界警方表示，他们对枪击案一无所知，随后的报告证实了这一点：韩虽然背部被枪手射出的四发子弹中的一发击中，但他选择驾车进入日占区，向日本当局报告此事。

由于韩未发出警报，枪手得以逃脱。租界警方的调查显示，周四中午前不久在修女路（Route des Soeurs）和拉达路拐角处被捕的一名男子不可能对此枪击案负责，该男子曾向警察开三枪，导致自己肩部受伤；据称在其手枪中发现了三发子弹，这解释了弹匣容纳的总共六发子弹的去向。

（批注：Read 16/9）

SHANGHAI TIMES.

SE 16 1939

POLICE OFFICER AT
FOO MIN HOSPITAL

Wounded Hungjao Area
Commandant Was Shot
In Concession

Mr. Han Chun, police commandant
of the Hungjao and other areas,
who was shot and wounded in the
back by a terrorist on Rue Delastre
on Thursday morning, was admitted
to the Foo Min Hospital on North
Szechuen Road shortly after the in-
cident.
His condition was reported to be
serious. The 53-year-old Shantung
native was believed to have been
shot at the instigation of gambling
operators in the outside roads areas
in the Western District, it was re-
ported yesterday. It had long been
known that since his assumption of
office as the police commandant of
the outlying Shanghai areas, Mr.
Han Chun had spared no efforts to
round up the "undesirable elements"
and the gangsters in those areas.

1939年9月16日

警官在
福民医院

受伤的虹桥地区
司令在租界
遭枪击

周四上午在德拉司脱路被恐怖分子背部枪击受伤的虹桥及其他地区警察司令韩春先生，在事发后不久被送入四川北路福民医院。
据报道，他的情况严重。据昨日报道，这位53岁的山东籍人士被认为是在西区越界筑路地区赌博经营者的唆使下遭枪击的。众所周知，自韩春先生担任上海外围地区警察司令以来，他不遗余力地取缔这些地区的“不良分子”和帮派分子。

1/2.

1939年6月17日上午9时15分，两名中国男子乘坐一辆由司机驾驶的汽车（工部局牌照号9235），在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）886号上海搬家公司对面、法租界一侧的路边停车，车头朝西。司机头戴白色制服帽，身穿白色司机工作服，下车后穿过马路进入车库，会见分公司经理，称代表其雇主租赁一辆搬家卡车。司机声称该卡车需前往靠近中山路的大西路（Great Western Road），将一些家具搬运至北苏州路荣康里（Yoong Keng Li）的一处地址。

分公司经理赵子敬（Tsao Ts Kyung）为确保卡车不驶入华界，便穿过马路来到那辆汽车旁（工部局牌照号9235）。他看见车内有两名中国男子，其中一人较为肥胖，年龄约35或40岁，身着西装，司机告知其姓梁（Liang）；另一人为较年轻的中国男子，年龄在20至30岁之间，身穿黑色长衫。赵子敬向前者提出交涉，要求保证不需要卡车驶入华界，因为该车未获许可这样做，

page_data.en:
1/3.

so, and also company regulations forbade it. Mr. Liang
assured the manager, that the removal van need go no
further than Great Western Road near Chungshan Road
and that it was required only to remove furniture to
an address on North Soochow Road.

Meanwhile, Ford Removal Van No.6, S.M.C. Licence
No. 17078 which had been summoned from the Gordon Road
Branch of the Shanghai Household Removal Company at
123 Gordon Road arrived with its complement of 1
chauffeur, Zee Poh Sung (徐福生) and four coolies.
Mr. Liang paid the sum of $10.00, for two hours hire,
in advance and thereupon, about 10 male Chinese, all
dressed in Canton silk jackets and pants, who had
(S.M.C.Lic.9235) all boarded the removal van
been waiting near the motor-car/(S.M.C. Licence No.
17078) the chauffeur of which was instructed to proceed
West on Avenue Edward VII following behind the above
motor-car.

Whilst proceeding along Avenue Edward VII, one
of the occupants of the van told the chauffeur that
the 4 coolies employed by the removal company were
not required as Mr. Liang had engaged his own men, who
were now on the van. He therefore suggested that the
company coolies be allowed to alight and return to
their garage. Zee Poh Sung accordingly stopped the
page_data.zh:
1/3.

且公司规定亦禁止此类行为。梁先生向经理保证，搬家卡车只需行至靠近中山路的大西路，仅需将家具搬运至北苏州路的一处地址。

与此同时，从戈登路123号上海搬家公司戈登路分部调来的福特搬家卡车第6号（工部局牌照号17078）抵达现场，随车配有1名司机徐福生（Zee Poh Sung）和4名苦力。梁先生预付了2小时的租车费10.00美元。随后，约10名身穿广东绸缎衣裤的中国男子——此前一直在那辆汽车（工部局牌照号9235）附近等候——全部登上搬家卡车。司机奉命沿爱多亚路向西行驶，跟随在上述汽车之后。

在沿爱多亚路行驶途中，卡车上的一名乘客告诉司机，搬家公司雇佣的4名苦力已不需要，因为梁先生已雇用自己的手下，这些人现在已在卡车上。因此，他建议让公司的苦力下车返回车库。徐福生遂将

page_data.en:
1/4.

van at the junction of Avenue Foch and Yates Road,
where the four removal company coolies alighted and
returned to their garage at 123 Gordon Road.

Following this, nothing further was heard or seen
of either the removal van or the chauffeur and at 3p.m.
17-8-39 when there was still no news, the Avenue Edward
VII Branch manager, Tsao Ts Kyung reported the matter
to the Head Office, G.E. Marden & Company, Ltd. 125
Hankow Road. Subsequently, enquiries made of the
watchman at Yeong Kong Li (葉康里), North Soochow
Road, the address to which the supposed furniture was
to be delivered, discovered that no removal van had
come to this alleyway. In view of the above the G.E.
Marden and Company Ltd. representatives came to this
station to make the above mentioned report and to
request that further investigations be made.

Enquiries at the Traffic Office disclosed that
the motor-car, S.M.C. Licence No. 9235, in which the
hirer of the van was riding, was registered in the
name of:- Jacob S.C.Wong, Chapel No. 437 Singapore Road.

The undersigned and C.D.C. 259 accompanied by
D.S. 698 Kagawaa (R.M.) proceeded to the Japanese
Gendarmerie Western District Headquarters, 94 Jessfield
Road and requested assistance to visit 437 Singapore
page_data.zh:
1/4.

卡车停在霞飞路（Avenue Foch）与 Yates Road 的交叉口，4名搬家公司的苦力在此下车，返回戈登路123号的车库。

此后，无论是搬家卡车还是司机均再无音讯。直到1939年8月17日下午3时，仍无消息，爱多亚路分部经理赵子敬向位于汉口路125号的总公司 G.E. Marden & Company, Ltd. 报告了此事。随后，经向拟交付家具的地址——北苏州路叶康里（Yeong Kong Li）的看门人查询，发现并无搬家卡车进入该弄堂。鉴于上述情况，G.E. Marden and Company Ltd. 的代表来到本警署作出上述报告，并请求进一步调查。

经向交通处查询，获悉租用卡车的乘车人所乘汽车（工部局牌照号9235）登记在以下人士名下：Jacob S.C.Wong，新加坡路437号礼拜堂。

署名人与刑事侦缉处警员259号，在日本宪兵队西区总部（杰斯菲尔德路94号）日方侦探 Kagawaa（R.M.，698号）的陪同下，前往新加坡路

page_data.en:
1/5.

Road, O.O.L. to question the owner of the motor-car.
Assistance was rendered, but on arrival at Singapore
Road near Connaught Road, it was learnt that the
address 437 Singapore Road was non-existent, the
house formerly bearing this number having been
demolished and a block of new buildings were in course
of construction on the old site. No information
regarding any person of the name of Jacob S.O. Wong,
owner of a motor-car, was forthcoming from residents
in this vicinity.

At the Western District Japanese Gendarmerie
Headquarters, 94 Jessfield Road, in reply to a further
query, detectives were informed that in the event of
the removal van having been detained for any reason
by the City Government Police Bureau, the above
gendarmerie headquarters would most certainly have
been informed but, that no report of such an occurrence
had been received. The Japanese gendarmerie Authorities
further undertook to make enquiries, whether the
removal van was being detained by other Japanese Army
units and to inform the Police, if this was the case.

At 10.15p.m. 17-8-39,Tung Ta Kyung, Avenue
Edward VII Branch Manager came to the station and
reported that he had just received word that the
page_data.zh:
1/5.

437号，以询问车主。日方提供了协助，但当到达靠近康纳路（Connaught Road）的新加坡路时，得知新加坡路437号这一地址并不存在，原挂此门牌号的房屋已被拆除，原址上正在建造一排新楼房。附近居民未能提供关于名为 Jacob S.O. Wong 的汽车车主的任何信息。

在杰斯菲尔德路94号的日本宪兵队西区总部，针对进一步的询问，侦探们被告知，如果搬家卡车因任何原因被市政府警察局扣留，上述宪兵队总部肯定会收到通知，但并未收到此类事件的报告。日本宪兵当局还承诺调查该搬家卡车是否被其他日军部队扣留，并在确有其事时通知警方。

1939年8月17日晚上10时15分，爱多亚路分部经理 Tung Ta Kyung 来到警署，报告称他刚收到消息，

page_data.en:
1/6.

chauffeur had returned with removal van, S.M.C. Licence
No. 17078, to the Branch Garage at 213 Gordon Road.
Detectives immediately proceeded to above address
where it was learned that the chauffeur and van had
returned to this garage at 9.30p.m. 17-8-39 after
having been commandeered by Japanese Army Authorities
engaged in a punitive expedition against Chinese
guerrillas in the Kiangwan area. However shortly
after his return the chauffeur had left again,
assertedly to visit a restaurant on Foochow Road to
try and collect payment for hire of the van from the
Japanese, who had used same and, who were now said to
be wining and dining in the Foochow Road restaurant.
As the chauffeur had still failed to return to
the Gordon Road Branch, Shanghai Household Removing
Company by 12.30a.m. 18-8-39, at 1.00a.m. detectives
proceeded to his home where the chauffeur Zee Foh
Sung (徐福生), 38, Shanghai, M/chauffeur (Permit
No. 5198) 81/194 Gordon Road was located, he having
just returned home.
Questioned by detectives Zee Foh Sung told the
following story:-
At 9.30a.m. 17-8-39, after the four removal
company coolies alighted from the removal van (S.M.C.
page_data.zh:
1/6.

司机已驾驶搬家卡车（工部局牌照号17078）返回戈登路213号的分部车库。侦探立即前往上述地址，获悉司机和卡车于1939年8月17日晚上9时30分返回该车库，此前该车被参与江湾地区围剿中国游击队的日军当局征用。然而，司机回来后不久又离开，声称要去福州路的一家餐馆，试图向使用过该车的日本人收取租车费，据说这些人目前正在福州路的餐馆宴饮。

由于截至1939年8月18日凌晨12时30分，司机仍未返回上海搬家公司戈登路分部，侦探于凌晨1时前往其住所。在那里找到了司机徐福生（Zee Foh Sung，即徐福生），38岁，上海人，职业司机（许可证号5198），住址为戈登路194号81室。他刚刚回到家。

经侦探讯问，徐福生讲述了以下经过：
1939年8月17日上午9时30分，在4名搬家公司的苦力于霞飞路与 Yates Road 交叉口从搬家卡车（工部局

page_data.en:
1/7

Lic.17078) at Avenue Foch and Yates Road he had continued
to drive the van West along Avenue Foch and Great
Western Road until he crossed Chungshan Road and was
directed by the occupants of his van to a Japanese
Military Post on Jernigan Road. Here he was told that
they must stop in order to obtain a permit from the
Japanese Authorities to remove the furniture. The 10
male Chinese then alighted from his van and loitered
around in the vicinity, whilst the occupants of the
motor-car (S.M.C. Licence 9235) which had preceded
them, entered the house.

About half an hour later, a detachment of Japanese
soldiers (about 10 in all) came out from the building
and commenced to load machine guns, rifles, boxes of
ammunition and hand grenades onto the Shanghai Household
Removal Company van and then the 10 Japanese soldiers
and the male Chinese also boarded the van and the
chauffeur was ordered to drive towards Kiangwan along
Chungshan Road via Pah Sa Jao (八字桥) and Liu Ying
Road. Enroute, the male Chinese travelling in the
driver's compartment of the removal van, dropped all
pretence of the reason for the hire of the van and
informed Lee Poh Sung, the chauffeur that they were pro-
Wang Ching Wei guerrillas and that they were accompany-
page_data.zh:
1/7

牌照号17078）下车后，他继续驾驶卡车沿霞飞路和大西路向西行驶，直至穿过中山路。随后，车上的乘客指示他前往杰尼根路（Jernigan Road）的一个日军哨所。在那里，他被告知必须停车，以便从日本当局获得搬运家具的许可证。那10名中国男子随即从他的卡车上下来，在附近徘徊，而此前跟随他们的那辆汽车（工部局牌照号9235）内的乘客则进入了屋内。

约半小时后，一队日本士兵（共约10人）从建筑物内出来，开始将机枪、步枪、弹药箱和手榴弹装载到上海搬家公司的卡车上。随后，这10名日本士兵和那些中国男子也登上卡车，司机奉命经八字桥（Pah Sa Jao）和刘行路（Liu Ying Road），沿中山路向江湾方向行驶。途中，坐在搬家卡车驾驶室里的中国男子不再掩饰租车的真实原因，并告诉司机李福生（Lee Poh Sung，即徐福生），他们是汪精卫派的游击队，正陪同

page_data.en:
1/8

ing the Japanese military detachment to attack Chinese
guerrillas operating in the vicinity of Kiangwan.

The removal van arrived at Kiangwan Village at
about 11.45a.m. 17-8-39 and the Japanese soldiers left
the van to partake of their mid-day meal. At about
1.30p.m. 17-8-39 the soldiers returned and ordered
the chauffeur to drive along a newly constructed road
to a place about 4 miles (Chinese li) from Kiangwan.
Soon after the Shanghai Household Removal Company van
arrived at this place motor-car (S.M.U. Lic.9238) in
which was riding a Japanese Officer and 4 male Chinese
including the chauffeur and the so called Mr. Liang.
The Japanese soldiers all alighted from the removal
van, arming themselves with the machine guns, rifles,
hand-grenades and ammunition. One soldier was left
to keep guard over the chauffeur and removal van,
whilst the remainder together with the Chinese marched
away.

At about 5p.m. 17-8-39 the Japanese soldiers
and Chinese in their party returned bringing with them
one prisoner, bound up with rope, and a quantity of
seized rifles in very bad condition. Three or four
male Chinese who had not previously come together with
the van, joined the party and all boarded the Shanghai
page_data.zh:
1/8.

日军分队去攻击在江湾附近活动的中国游击队。

搬家卡车于1939年8月17日上午11时45分左右抵达江湾村，日本士兵下车吃午饭。1939年8月17日下午1时30分左右，士兵们返回，命令司机沿一条新建道路行驶至距离江湾约4英里（华里）的地方。上海搬家公司卡车抵达该地后不久，一辆汽车（工部局牌照号9238）也到达，车上坐着一名日本军官和4名中国男子，其中包括司机和所谓的梁先生。所有日本士兵从搬家卡车上下来，带上机枪、步枪、手榴弹和弹药。留下一名士兵看守司机和搬家卡车，其余人员与中国男子一同步行离开。

1939年8月17日下午5时左右，同行的日本士兵和中国人员返回，带回一名被绳索捆绑的俘虏，以及一批在战斗中缴获的状况极差的步枪。另有三四名此前未随卡车前来的中国男子加入队伍，所有人登上了上海

page_data.en:
1/9

Household Removal Company van, which was thereupon
directed to return via Paoshan Road to the Japanese
military post from where they had started out that
morning.

The party arrived at the Jernigan Road Japanese
military post at about 6.15p.m. 17-8-39 here the
Japanese soldiers alighted taking the Chinese prisoner
with them.

The removal van now containing only the male
Chinese party was ordered to proceed to Tsau Wo Ching
(漕河泾) via Hungjao Road and Zia Tu Road. On
arrival at about 7p.m. 17-8-39 the Chinese passengers
alighted, taking with them the rifles and ammunition
captured during the engagement with the Chinese
guerrillas. The party entered the former model
prison at Tsau Wo Ching which apparently was their
headquarters. On their return about half an hour
later, on the chauffeur's request for payment for the
hire of the van, he was given a piece of paper bearing
a chop "The Shanghai Armed Police Commander's Headquarters"
and stating:-

"Shanghai Household Removing Co.
As the Officer in charge of this Department
is out on official business the total of the
account will be paid tomorrow, $25.00 paid in
advance."

Stamped as above (General
Affairs Department).
page_data.zh:
1/9

搬家公司的卡车，随后卡车奉命经宝山路返回当天早晨出发的日军哨所。

队伍于1939年8月17日下午6时15分左右抵达杰尼根路的日军哨所，日本士兵在此下车，并将中国俘虏带走。

此时卡车上仅剩中国人员，他们奉命经虹桥路（Hungjao Road）和斜土路（Zia Tu Road）前往漕河泾（Tsau Wo Ching）。约于1939年8月17日晚上7时抵达后，中国乘客下车，带走了在与中国游击队交战中缴获的步枪和弹药。该伙人进入了漕河泾的前模范监狱，那里显然是他们的总部。约半小时后他们返回，当司机要求支付租车费时，他得到了一张盖有“上海武装警察司令部”印章的纸条，上面写着：

“上海搬家公司：
因本部门主管外出公干，账目总额将于明日支付，已预付25.00美元。”

加盖上述印章（总务处）。

page_data.en:
1/10

Several of the male Chinese again boarded the
removal van at Tsau Wo Ching to return to Shanghai at
about 7.30p.m. 17-8-39 but on arrival at the Japanese
barrier on Chungshan Road the van was stopped by the
sentries and detained until the male Chinese (Mr. Liang)
had arrived in motor-car (S.M.C. Lic. 9235) and made
arrangements with the Japanese military for them to pass.
At 8.30p.m. 17-8-39 the removal van was again
stopped by Japanese sentries at the Great Western Road
barrier and the same procedure had to be gone through
again, before they were allowed to proceed at about 9p.m.
17-8-39.
No further delay was encountered and the chauffeur
drove direct to the Shanghai Household Removal Company
garage at 213 Gordon Road. His passengers alighted at
Gordon Road stating they were going to the Mei Yuen
(梅園) Restaurant on Foochow Road for their dinner.
After parking his van the chauffeur decided to
also go to the Mei Yuen Restaurant to try and collect
the hire account, but though he waited there until
closing time none of his passengers visited this place.
He then took his evening meal at a nearby food-shop
and returned home at 12.30a.m. 18-8-39.
Statements of the Avenue Edward VII Branch manager,
the four coolies and the chauffeur are appended to this
report.

D. S. R.

1/10

1939年8月17日晚上7时30分左右，几名中国男子再次登上搬家卡车，从漕河泾返回上海。但当到达中山路的日军关卡时，卡车被哨兵拦下并扣留，直到那名中国男子（梁先生）驾驶汽车（工部局牌照号9235）赶到，并与日军安排放行后才得以通过。1939年8月17日晚上8时30分，搬家卡车在大西路关卡再次被日本哨兵拦下，不得不重复同样的程序，才于1939年8月17日晚上9时左右获准通行。

此后未再遇到延误，司机直接驾车前往戈登路213号的上海搬家公司车库。乘客在戈登路下车，称他们要去福州路的梅园（Mei Yuen）餐馆吃晚饭。停好卡车后，司机决定也去梅园餐馆，试图收取租车费，但他一直等到打烊，也没有任何乘客光顾此地。随后他在附近的一家小吃店吃了晚饭，并于1939年8月18日凌晨12时30分回家。

爱多亚路分部经理、4名苦力及司机的陈述附于本报告之后。

随后，名叫徐福松（音译）的司机驾驶同一辆卡车沿爱德华七世路向西行驶至重庆路。他让我们下车，因为顾客有自己的苦力，不需要我们的服务。

machine guns, a box of ammunition and 1 box of hand grenade.
They told me to drive to Kiangwan and I complied.
At about 11.45a.m. we arrived at Kiangwan, where the
Japanese soldiers alighted from the truck and partook of their
mid day meal. At 1.30p.m. the Japanese soldiers returned to

marched away leaving one soldier to keep guard over me. I
do not know the name of this place.
At 5p.m. they returned with more than 10 captured rifles
and one arrested male Chinese. They instructed me to drive
to the Japanese Military Headquarters on Jernigan Road. On
arrival at this place at 6.15p.m. the Japanese soldiers brought
away the arrested male Chinese, leaving all the Chinese
coolies in the truck and ordered me to proceed to the Zao Wo
Ching Gaol.
At about 7p.m. the truck arrived at Zao Wo Ching Gaol.
The Chinese coolies took down the rifles which they obtained
in Kwangwan and went into the gaol. At about 7.30p.m. 6
male Chinese coolies came out of the gaol and ordered me to
drive back to Shanghai. They told me that they were the
guerrillas under Mr. Wong Ching Wei's control.
On arrival at the railway near Chung San Road, the
truck was stopped by the Japanese soldiers. Later, a male
Chinese, riding in a motor car bearing S.M.C. Lic. 6638,
attended the scene and spoke some words to the Japanese

机枪、一箱弹药和一箱手榴弹。
他们让我开往江湾，我照办了。
上午11点45分左右，我们到达江湾，日本士兵下车吃午饭。下午1点30分，日本士兵回到卡车上，指示我驶离江湾约4英里，随后他们命令我停车并步行离开，留下一名士兵看守我。我不知道这个地方的名字。
下午5点，他们带着缴获的十多支步枪和一名被捕的中国男子回来。他们指示我开往仁记路（Jernigan Road）的日本海军司令部。下午6点15分到达该地后，日本士兵带走了被捕的中国男子，将所有中国苦力留在卡车上，并命令我前往曹家渡监狱。
晚上7点左右，卡车到达曹家渡监狱。中国苦力卸下他们在江湾获得的步枪，进入监狱。晚上7点30分左右，6名中国男苦力从监狱出来，命令我开车回上海。他们告诉我，他们是王敬伟（音译）先生控制下的游击队。

The following is the further statement of Wei Zung Tsoo (魏宗祖)
native of Shanghai taken by me D.S.I. Soong Ping Tsung
translated

I first became acquainted with Sung Ying Ping
(宋英平) through the introduction of one named Han Chuin
(韩春) in an opium den situated on Route Kraetzer, near
the Food Market. I have known Sung Ying Ping for about
two months only. Sung Ying Ping and Han Chuin usually
came to my home for amusement, and sometimes he (Sung) visited
me by himself. One day, he (Sung) asked a loan of a few
dollars from me, but this was refused. He then went away
unpleased.

On 24th. July, 1939, I was apprehended and conveyed
to the Police Headquarters. A few minutes later, I saw
Sung Ying Ping hand-cuffed and he implicated me as an
accomplice before the Japanese Gendarmerie and Foreign
detectives. I have no idea why he was arrested and also
why he implicated me as his accomplice. He may hate me
because I refused to grant a loan to him.

Sung Ying Ping, aged 40 years, native of Shantung,
height 5'7", strong build, long face, dark complexion, with
some wrinkles on forehead.

Formerly, he (Sung) was a soldier together with
Han Chuin, Commander of Armed Police. Sung, who is illiterate
and has a bad temper. I suppose that Sung is still in the
custody of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters.

This is a true statement.

Signed:- Wei Zung Tsoo

以下是我，刑事调查副督察长宋秉宗（Soong Ping Tsung），于1939年8月1日在中央捕房总局C1室，由书记员夏（Hsia）翻译，对上海籍人士魏宗祖（Wei Zung Tsoo，魏宗祖）所作的进一步供词记录：

我最初是通过一个叫韩春（Han Chuin，韩春）的人在靠近菜市场的克拉策尔路（Route Kraetzer）一家鸦片馆介绍认识宋英平（Sung Ying Ping，宋英平）的。我认识宋英平仅约两个月。宋英平和韩春常来我家消遣，有时他（宋）也独自来访。有一天，他（宋）向我借几块钱，但被我拒绝。随后他不高兴地离开了。

1939年7月24日，我被捕并被押送至警察总局。几分钟后，我看见宋英平戴着手铐，他在日本宪兵队和外籍侦探面前诬陷我为同伙。我不知道他为何被捕，也不知道他为何诬陷我为同伙。他可能因为我拒绝借钱给他而恨我。

宋英平，40岁，山东人，身高5英尺7英寸，体格强壮，长脸，肤色黝黑，额头有些皱纹。

以前，他（宋）与武装警察指挥官韩春一起当过兵。宋不识字且脾气暴躁。我想宋目前仍被拘押在日本宪兵队总部。

此供词属实。

The 200 members of the Armed Police Head-quarters, under the command of Zee Chia San (徐家山); a company commander, who were transferred from Zau Woo Kying to Nan Sing Jao on the Shanghai-Hangchow Railway line on June 14, were again transferred to Nan Jao Village, Fengyien, Footung, on June 20. with headquarters at Wang Ka Hwo Yuan Garden (黃家花園),

are being enrolled by force and more than 1,000 have
been detained and isolated in the former Kiangsu Model

Under the auspices of the Special Service
Section of the Japanese Military, an "Armed Police
Headquarters (武裝警察總司令部) has been established
at Zau Wo Kying and commenced functioning on April
10th. One Han Chun (韓鈞), age about 50, native
of Honan, a former brigadier general under the
command of Marshal Wu Pei-fu (吳佩孚) has been
appointed Chief of the "headquarters" with Colonel
Nishimura, ex-Senior Advisor to the "Shanghai City
Government," who was relieved of his former post for
being concerned in an opium smuggling case, as Advisor.
The "headquarters" comprise (1) Adjutants Office,
(2) Staff Office, (3) Secretariat, (4) Military Court,
(5) Military Supplies Department, (6) Medical Service
Department, (7) General Affairs Department, and
(8) Intelligence Office.

According to the plans drawn up, an armed
police force of 15,000 men will be organized, some
400 constables having at present enlisted by the
"headquarters". In this connection, it is reported
that endeavours are being made meantime to induce
Chinese guerillas to surrender to the Japanese who
will incorporate them into the above force.
